page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture configured with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, resulting in a thread-per-core ratio of 1.0. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. A key technical constraint of the underlying processor configuration is the absence of advanced instruction sets; CPU flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA_NI), and bit manipulation (BMI2, FMA) are unavailable. Hyperthreading is also not supported on this hardware configuration.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of advanced vector processing or high-throughput local disk I/O. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, and general-purpose utility tasks that do not rely on specialized cryptographic or mathematical acceleration.
